content: {"summary":"To distinguish a CPX‑E600 caused by our client certificate expiring (January 2025) from one caused by the processor rotating its CA (December 2025), check the expiration date of the client‑cert secret and the exact error text in the proxy logs. The secret’s notAfter field shows our cert’s validity, while log messages containing “x509: certificate has expired” point to the processor’s cert, and “remote error: tls: expired certificate” indicates the remote (processor) cert is expired. The December 2025 incident was a known processor CA rotation.","likely_cause":"The CPX‑E600 can stem from either our client certificate reaching its notAfter date or the processor’s CA rotation; the evidence provides a method to tell which is occurring.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Our client certificate expiration is visible in the secret’s notAfter field","evidence_ids":["RB-023#2"],"quote":"notAfter=Jan 14 00:00:00 2025 GMT"},{"text":"If proxy logs show “x509: certificate has expired” the processor’s certificate was rejected","evidence_ids":["RB-023#2"],"quote":"If the proxy log shows x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid"},{"text":"The log entry “remote error: tls: expired certificate” indicates the remote (processor) certificate is expired","evidence_ids":["RB-023#1"],"quote":"CPX-E600 handshake failed: remote error: tls: expired certificate"},{"text":"A CA rotation on the processor side occurred in December 2025 and caused similar failures","evidence_ids":["INC-0110#0"],"quote":"On the evening of 19 December 2025 a CA rotation on the card processor's side broke"}],"next_checks":["Run `kubectl get secret card-processor-client-tls -o jsonpath='{.data.tls\\.crt}' | base64 -d | openssl x509 -noout -enddate` to verify our client cert’s notAfter date","Inspect recent proxy logs for the exact error string: either “x509: certificate has expired” or “remote error: tls: expired certificate”","Confirm whether a processor CA rotation was announced or logged around December 2025","If our client cert is expired, generate a new CSR and replace the secret as described in RB‑023#3‑6"]}
